title: Reward history and involuntary attention
summary: EEG study on whether previously rewarded distractors keep capturing attention after reward stops. Data collected, needs a modelling angle.

title: Overnight consolidation of associative memories
summary: Overnight sleep EEG with a paired-associates task. Room for a second memory paradigm in the same sessions.

title: Bilingual word learning in the classroom
summary: School-based study of novel word retention in bilingual 5-7 year olds. Would like to add an EEG session for a subset.

title: Feasibility of infant MEG for auditory paradigms
summary: Scoping whether our MEG setup can be adapted for infants. Very early — mostly needs people who have tried and failed at this before.

title: Neural signatures of exploration under uncertainty
summary: MEG plus RL modelling of an explore/exploit bandit task. Analysis well underway.

title: Visual working memory capacity and distractor filtering
summary: Psychophysics on filtering efficiency. Could extend to fMRI if a lab with scanner time is interested.

title: Associative memory deficits in healthy ageing
summary: Undergraduate thesis project comparing associative and item memory in older adults.

title: Department-wide preprocessing standards
summary: Proposal to agree on shared BIDS and preprocessing conventions so datasets can be reused across labs.
